audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-3 were all scored Gangplank at 8/10 while whys[0] says 'He is even at level 1 and no bully', whys[1] says 'Both of you are scaling here', and whys[2] calls level 3 'a coinflip, not a loss'. Levels 4-5 and first item were scored Skill while whys[3] and whys[5] describe them as your poke coming online and your all-in timing.
audit.why: 56.51% over 1690 games with a lane that starts even and tilts from the second keg charge onward. The packet chart (Skill, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank) matches the prose row for row.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to the packet chart, ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's spike rows are pure boilerplate — 'Trinity Force is your spike', 'Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in' — and named no Yone ability at all.
audit.why: The real level-6 change is Fate Sealed blinking 1000 units behind the last champion in a line and dragging everyone back, and the real first-item change is Sheen out-bursting the shield Spirit Cleave regenerates every 14 seconds. Neither figure was anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Both written into phases[4].why and phases[5].why with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] says 'Q-cleanse his slows' and the whole full layer keys its cooldown tracking to Soul Unbound with no number. Spirit Cleave — the shield that decides whether your detonation lands — is never mentioned in the full layer at all.
audit.why: Gangplank's cleanse is W. And the punishable timings are concrete: Mortal Steel is 4s so the third-cast knockup is always near, Spirit Cleave is a flat 14s shield, Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 falling to 10s. Committing a keg chain into a fresh Spirit Cleave is the single most common way this trade is thrown away.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the do's, don'ts and trade rules; Remove Scurvy named as the cleanse.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly calls Soul Unbound an 'E-rewind health' that lets Yone 'snap back to the body to undo the health and distance' (whys[5], spikes[2], late, wants.foe[1]).
audit.why: Riot's text for Soul Unbound says only that his spirit leaves his body, gains Move Speed, and on ending is forced back to the body where 'he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit'. There is nothing about undoing health taken. I could not verify the health-rewind claim from the kit, so I did not restate it in the full layer and wrote only what Riot's text supports.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d describe the snap-back and the repeated damage; the content sentences making the health claim were left untouched rather than guessed at.

edits.before: Barrel-poke his combo — Q-cleanse, kite his E burst. Gangplank wins the Soul Unbound cooldown windows.
edits.after: Barrel-poke his combo and hold W for the Q3 knockup. You take the lane from level 4 onward.

edits.before: Q-poke costs him HP and pays you gold. Identify how Yone contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Even at 1 — he is no bully here. Deny his last-hits and don't plant a keg he can walk over and free-hit.

edits.before: First barrel chains start zoning his wave positions. Only take the trade when Yone's Soul Unbound is down.
edits.after: Both of you are still scaling. Trade with Parrrley and keep low-HP kegs where his Q can't reach them.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Yone must walk into your range.
edits.after: Mortal Steel's third cast dashes and knocks up on a 4s cooldown into Spirit Cleave's shield — a coinflip, not a loss.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Soul Unbound's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Second Parrrley rank and keg charge bring poke online — set the keg on the wave so he eats the explosion every time he steps up.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — watch the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yone's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage zones the angle his R needs — it blinks 1000 units behind your line and drags everyone in, so deny the path.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Soul Unbound's cooldown.
edits.after: Sheen plus a chained detonation out-bursts the shield Spirit Cleave gives him every 14s. Force it.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Yone carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Yone caps as a mid-game duelist — chained kegs and global Cannon Barrage zone him from outside his Q3 dash.

edits.before: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Yone steps to farm, and orange away whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Yone steps to farm, and hold W for his Q3, not for chip.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Committing into a fresh Spirit Cleave — that 14s shield absorbs your whole keg detonation.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Poke there. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: E is 22s at rank 1 and snaps him back to his body — poke him at the snap.

edits.before: Yone wastes Soul Unbound — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy is W, not Q — hold it for his commit, not chip.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks make the third a dash-knockup, on a 4s cooldown.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: In spirit form he repeats part of the damage he dealt when it ends.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s, so a whiffed chain means he wins the next trade.
